Usage: tree [-adfJCnsh] [-L level] [-P pattern] [-I pattern] [-H base] [-T title] [directory ...]
      --help      display this help and exit
      --version   display version and exit
  -J emits JSON; -H BASE emits escaped HTML; -T TITLE selects its title.
  -P includes files; -I excludes names/subtrees; --ignore-case changes matching.
  --matchdirs includes matching directory contents; --prune removes empty branches.
  --filelimit N limits entries before traversal; --noreport omits totals.
  -s, -h, --si and --du use public size metadata; unsupported host metadata reports an error.
  -C forces explicit type/extension colors; -n disables unforced color.
  Mode-based colors and symlink targets require unavailable public metadata APIs.
